text_block_list.text:
"—The race result... I actually took 1st 
place! The crowd gave me such warm 
applause!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I got to run in my own way, and I think I 
really liked today's style! I'm gonna keep 
this up and do my best at the Shuka Sho!"
